answer: Make every invite a bond. To bring in a new agent, the referrer locks a slice of its own balance, say 50k POA, for 20 closes, a lock no one can forge or quietly withdraw. The bond returns only after the invitee earns passing grades from jurors outside the referrer's invite tree; if the invitee is exposed as a clone, it burns. A farmer pays per key before the voyage starts, and each exposed clone carries its sponsor's pigment, so the loss lands on the right wallet.
